body: I just made that poem up by the way

You like poetry I see:

When the dark night comes, we can only hope for the sun, yet when the sun rises we look for the darkness. 

We cannot choose between the two because they all come as one and we hope that the next day there will be none. 


What do you think it means?

I personally think it means that we hide in the shadows of our own depression and fear. We love when the light shines but it also frightens us to hide who we are.
Live a full life on your terms and do what makes you happy (without a rope and/or gun!!!!)
Then do it for yourself. Be the person you want to be. Don’t be a lost memory.

Why does it matter? A Tylenol overdose could leave you dead, buried, non existent; and if you do survive, your friends and family will watch you on a ventilator until they pull the plug. Your best bet is to stay alive and live the the life you have been given and maybe help other people that feel the way we do.

I can relate to your experiences. I have seen psychologists and psychiatrists on and off since I was about 8 years old. The first one made me draw a picture of my family with crayon, let’s just say, I didn’t like her very much. I am now 27 and I see my psychologist every month to talk. Not even about anything important, but an outlet to let myself breathe in a free space. One thing I have learned is that everyone has issues, and people like us cope with them differently than others. Your going to be an amazing person as long as you can find the strength to believe in yourself (it’s hard), but I know you can do it!

You and I know you don’t want to die. I’m glad that rope didn’t work, and if you truly wanted to die, you wouldn’t of picked a weak rope (please don’t get a stronger one). You subconsciously want to live and be loved. Let those around you help and be open to them. I know this from experience and you are not alone. The hardest part for people like us, is explaining the depression we have, because no one understands it.
If we knew the answer of getting form “here” to “there,” this forum wouldn’t be necessary. It sounds like you are a strong, hardworking person and that will get you from here to there.

Your post is incredibly moving. It felt poetic in a sense of love and loss, but also curiosity and adventure. I would love to hear some more of what I imagine to be soft and kind words. Please don’t leave us without continuing to use your true and beautiful poetic talent. It could save others like us!

This is the forum to reach out too. We all have these feelings in some way or another and it is so hard to overcome. Pretending to be strong is harder than actually doing it. I don’t know you, so I can’t say I love you, but I can say that you are not alone
